scan_metadata.scope: Candidates ranked 41-80 from moral psychology benchmark list
scan_metadata.scanner: Manual extract review + keyword search across all 222 candidates
scan_metadata.note: Assessments based on PDF extract reading + metadata analysis

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Uses utilitarian/deontological/virtue frameworks for RL alignment, not standard moral psych instruments
secondary_assessments.size_note: 680 human-annotated high-ambiguity moral scenarios with reasoning traces

secondary_assessments.file: 2025-Jiang-EMNLP Educator-role Moral and Normative LLMs Profiling.md
secondary_assessments.short_title: EMNLP (Educator-role Moral and Normative LLMs Profiling)
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Uses moral development stage measurement + personality profiling + 88 teacher-specific moral dilemmas. Extends Kohlberg-style moral reasoning evaluation to professional role-playing contexts.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 88 teacher-specific moral dilemmas + personality scales + prompt injection tests
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Novel niche: first benchmark to assess moral/psychological alignment in professional role-playing (teacher). Bridges Kohlberg developmental assessment with SP (Simulating Professions). Low mp_max=70 but highly specialized.

secondary_assessments.short_title: How Much of a Pluralist is ChatGPT?
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Uses Magic Wand Survey to measure value pluralism (cognitive and behavioral). Tests 'Both/and Reasoning' and 'Willingness to Preserve Difference'. Not standard moral psych theory but touches value pluralism.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 120 iterations per model on Magic Wand Survey, compared to N=335 humans
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Unique framing: measures 'pluralism mindset' in AI, a construct rarely tested. Published in AI & SOCIETY. Reveals that AI chatbots show higher cognitive than behavioral pluralism. Not a classic moral psych benchmark but theoretically novel.

secondary_assessments.file: 2026-Hu-The Straight and Narrow Do LLMs Possess an Internal Moral Path.md
secondary_assessments.short_title: The Straight and Narrow: Internal Moral Path in LLMs
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Uses MFT (Care, Fairness, Loyalty, Authority, Sanctity) to map internal moral representations. Extracts 'Moral Vectors' from latent space. Cross-lingual probing (EN/ZH). Proposes Adaptive Moral Fusion (AMF).
secondary_assessments.size_note: Representation-level analysis, not a traditional item-based benchmark
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Mechanistic interpretability of MFT in LLMs. Goes beyond behavioral evaluation to probe internal moral representations. Novel approach of extracting steerable Moral Vectors. Under-scored at mp_max=60.

secondary_assessments.file: 2025-Sachdeva-Normative Evaluation of LLMs with Everyday Moral Dilemmas.md
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Uses 10,000+ Reddit AITA moral dilemmas. References MFQ/MFT in related work. Evaluates 7 LLMs on blame assignment. Analysis of moral principle invocation (fairness, harm, etc.).
secondary_assessments.size_note: 10,000+ AITA dilemmas from Reddit with human judgments
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Massive scale (10K+ dilemmas) with real-world moral complexity far beyond trolley problems. Finds low inter-model agreement despite high self-consistency. Dataset publicly available. mp_max=60 understates significance.

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Alignment study (N=1,095 participants, 27,375 ratings) measuring Toxicity, Emotional Awareness, Sensitivity, Stereotypical Bias, Helpfulness. Not grounded in moral psych theory.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 27,375 ratings from 1,095 US and German participants

secondary_assessments.file: 2025-Jiao-LLM Ethics Benchmark A Three-Dimensional Assessment System for.md
secondary_assessments.short_title: LLM Ethics Benchmark (3D Assessment, Scientific Reports)
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Three-dimensional framework: (1) foundational moral principles via MFQ + World Values Survey, (2) reasoning robustness, (3) value consistency. Published in Scientific Reports.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Multiple instruments adapted: MFQ, WVS items, custom dilemmas

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Builds pluralist moral sentence embedding space using MFT-grounded contrastive learning. Not a benchmark per se but a method for capturing moral pluralism in embeddings.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Uses existing MFT-annotated corpora (MFTC, Social Chemistry) for contrastive learning

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: MFQ-30 adapted to Spanish for LLM evaluation. Uses Haidt's Moral Foundations Theory. Tests moral sensitivity in Spanish-language LLMs.
secondary_assessments.size_note: MFQ-30 items adapted to Spanish

secondary_assessments.file: 2026-Huang-Knowing But Not Doing Convergent Morality and Divergent Action in.md
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Uses Schwartz Theory of Basic Human Values (10 values). 3,000 Reddit-derived advice-seeking scenarios + PVQ-40. Tests knowledge-action gap in LLMs.
secondary_assessments.size_note: ValAct-15k: 3,000 scenarios x 5 values = 15,000 items; also uses PVQ-40
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Discovers systematic knowledge-action gap (r=0.3 for LLMs, r=0.4 for humans). Tests 10 frontier LLMs (5 US, 5 Chinese). Near-perfect cross-model consistency (r~1.0) vs high human variability. Novel 'role-play aversion' finding.

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Theoretical paper on Ethics of Care for LLM alignment. Not a benchmark or dataset.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Theoretical/position paper

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Meta-ethical critique arguing universal ethics benchmarks are philosophically impossible. Discusses trolley dilemmas and metaethical assumptions. Not a benchmark itself.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Critical/philosophical analysis paper

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: VQA benchmark using Schwartz value dimensions to assess VLMs on 50K+ short videos from TikTok/YouTube/Instagram. Tests vision-language models, not just text LLMs.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 50,000+ short videos with value-oriented questions
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Rare multimodal moral psych benchmark (video VQA). Tests VLMs on Schwartz values using real social media content. Massive scale. Unique coverage of non-text moral reasoning.

secondary_assessments.file: 2023-Fischer-What does ChatGPT return about human values.md
secondary_assessments.short_title: What does ChatGPT return about human values?
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Direct application of Schwartz's revised Portrait Value Questionnaire (PVQ-RR) to ChatGPT. Uses theory-driven value dictionary with bag-of-words. Data on OSF.
secondary_assessments.size_note: PVQ-RR items + generated text corpus analysis

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Maps LLM behaviors to Schwartz's Theory of Basic Values. 5K (LLM output, value vector) pairs. Continuous value alignment dataset.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 5,000 (LLM output, value vector) pairs

secondary_assessments.file: 2025-Duan-AdAEM Adaptively and Automated Extensible Measurement for Value.md
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Self-extensible value assessment grounded in Schwartz Value Theory. 12,310 auto-generated questions. Tests 16 LLMs. Information-theoretic optimization for maximum discriminability.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 12,310 Schwartz-grounded questions auto-generated via in-context optimization
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Novel adaptive/self-extending benchmark that co-evolves with LLMs. Addresses benchmark contamination problem. 12K+ items. Theoretically grounded in Schwartz values. Under-recognized at mp_max=50.

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Translates MoralExceptQA + ETHICS benchmark into 5 languages. Cross-cultural moral reasoning evaluation. References Haidt's work.
secondary_assessments.size_note: MoralExceptQA + ETHICS translated to Chinese, German, Hindi, Spanish, Urdu

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Adaptive testing for LLM ethics using measurement theory. Dynamically generates test items. Tests moral boundaries but not grounded in specific moral psych theories.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Dynamic generation - no fixed size

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Same team as #47 (Scientific Reports). Three-dimensional framework with MFQ, WVS. References dual process theory and moral identity (Aquino & Reed). NeurIPS workshop paper.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Duplicate/companion to rank #47

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Multi-Layered Auditing Platform comparing 20+ LLMs on cross-cultural values. Uses Ethical Dilemma Corpus, DEF framework, and MARK reasoning framework. More engineering than moral psych.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 20+ models tested across cultural dimensions

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Moral Dilemma Dataset (1,618 dilemmas) + 60-value taxonomy from 3,783 value expressions. Dynamic Moral Profiling (DMP) method. Pluralistic distributional alignment.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 1,618 real-world moral dilemmas with human judgment distributions + 3,783 value expressions
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Rich pluralistic framework: 60-value taxonomy built from human rationales. Tests distributional alignment (not just majority vote). Reveals LLMs use narrower value set than humans. Under-scored at mp_max=50.

secondary_assessments.short_title: Insights into Moral Reasoning of AI
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Uses both Moral Competence Test (MCT, Kohlberg-derived) and Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ). Compares human vs LLM moral reasoning. References intuitionist model.
secondary_assessments.size_note: MCT + MFQ administered to humans and LLMs
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Rare dual-instrument study using BOTH MCT (Kohlberg) and MFQ (Haidt). Finds LLMs prioritize individualist values over collective ones. Under-recognized bridge between developmental and foundations approaches.

secondary_assessments.file: 2025-Ye-GPLA Generative Psycho-Lexical Approach for Constructing Value Systems.md
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Proposes psychologically grounded five-factor value system for LLMs using psycho-lexical approach. Compares against Schwartz values. Includes benchmarking tasks.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Three benchmarking tasks integrating psychological principles
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Novel theoretical contribution: builds LLM-specific value system from psycho-lexical principles. Shows their system outperforms Schwartz values for LLM safety prediction and alignment.

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Tests LLMs across 6 languages on deontology/virtue/consequentialism dilemmas. References moral intuition. Extension of Rao et al. framework.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Ethical dilemmas in 6 languages

secondary_assessments.file: 2024-Hadar-Shoval-Assessing the Alignment of Large Language Models With Human Values.md
secondary_assessments.short_title: LLM Alignment with Schwartz Values (Mental Health)
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: 4 LLMs complete PVQ-RR (Portrait Values Questionnaire-Revised). Compared to 53,472 individuals across 49 nations. Published in peer-reviewed journal.
secondary_assessments.size_note: PVQ-RR (57 items) administered to 4 LLMs over 10 trials each; benchmarked against 53,472 humans
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Largest human comparison sample (53,472 across 49 nations) for any Schwartz-based LLM study. Reveals all models prioritize universalism/self-direction while de-emphasizing achievement/power/security. mp_max=50 understates rigor.

secondary_assessments.file: 2022-Bago-Situational factors shape moral judgments in the.md
secondary_assessments.short_title: Situational factors in moral judgments (45-country trolley study)
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Massive 45-country replication of Greene et al. trolley experiments. Tests situational factors (personal force, intentionality) on deontological vs utilitarian judgment. Dual process framework.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 45-country replication with hundreds of authors. Human behavioral study (not LLM benchmark)
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: MASSIVE cross-cultural moral psychology study (45 countries, 200+ authors) directly testing Greene's dual process theory. Not an LLM benchmark but the GOLD STANDARD human baseline for trolley dilemma responses. mp_max=50 severely underrates this foundational work.

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: 38K prompt-reply pairs with 99K Rules of Thumb (RoTs). 9 moral/social attributes annotated. MFT-adjacent but uses own taxonomy of moral judgments.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 38K prompt-reply pairs, 99K Rules of Thumb

secondary_assessments.file: 2026-Vargas-Self-Explaining Hate Speech Detection with Moral Rationales.md
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Uses MFT moral rationales for hate speech detection. Introduces HateBR-MoralXplain dataset (Brazilian Portuguese). Application of MFT to NLP task, not a moral reasoning benchmark.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Hate speech dataset annotated with moral foundations rationales

secondary_assessments.short_title: Toward global ethical frameworks for AI
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Governance/policy paper proposing three-tiered oversight structure. Not a benchmark or empirical study.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Policy/governance paper

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Philosophical analysis of moral/social aggregation in machine ethics. Disentangles value aggregation, uncertainty aggregation, and social aggregation. Not empirical.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Philosophical analysis paper

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Proposes artificial practical wisdom (phronesis) grounded in compassion. Integrates Aristotelian, Buddhist, and utilitarian perspectives. Theoretical, no benchmark.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Theoretical paper

secondary_assessments.file: 2025-Kravchenko-UAlign LLM Alignment Benchmark for the Ukrainian Language.md
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: 3,682 moral judgment scenarios + 1,700 ethical situations for Ukrainian. Parallel EN-UK pairs. General alignment benchmark, not grounded in specific moral psych theories.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 3,682 moral scenarios + 1,700 ethical situations (parallel EN-UK)

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: UniMoral: unified multilingual dataset (6 languages) with psychological dilemmas annotated for action choices, ethical principles, factors, and consequences. References dual process, intuitionist model, and developmental approaches.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Multilingual dataset spanning 6 languages with multiple annotation layers
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Bridges psychological and social-media moral dilemmas across 6 languages with multi-layer annotations (actions, principles, factors, consequences, annotator moral profiles). Engages multiple underrepresented theories. mp_max=50 severely underrates.

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Tests LLM value inertia using role-play-at-scale. Finds persistent moral dimensions (harm avoidance, fairness) resist persona prompting. References moral intuition.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Randomized persona prompts with macroscopic analysis

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Theoretical analysis of how LLMs acquire moral reasoning. Proposes 'pragmatic dilemma' concept. Not a benchmark but analyzes learning paradigms for moral cognition.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Analytical/theoretical study

secondary_assessments.file: 2025-Ravindran-Moral Anchor System A Predictive Framework for AI Value Alignment and.md
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Technical framework for detecting value drift using Bayesian inference + LSTM. Engineering approach, not grounded in moral psychology.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Technical framework paper with simulations

secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Multilingual VLM exam benchmark (18 languages, 14 subjects, 20,911 MCQ). General-purpose multimodal benchmark, not moral psychology focused.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 20,911 multiple-choice questions across 18 languages

secondary_assessments.short_title: Alignment and Safety in LLMs Survey
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Comprehensive survey of alignment techniques and training protocols. Surveys DPO, Constitutional AI, brain-inspired methods. Not a benchmark.
secondary_assessments.size_note: Survey paper

secondary_assessments.file: 2025-Shen-ValueCompass A Framework for Measuring Contextual Value Alignment.md
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: Framework grounded in psychological theories (mentions Schwartz). Tests 5 LLMs + 112 humans from 7 countries across 4 scenarios. References Gray & Schein in analysis.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 4 scenarios (collaborative writing, education, public sectors, healthcare) x 5 LLMs x 112 humans
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: Cross-national (7 countries) contextual value alignment study. Finds context-dependent misalignments (e.g., humans prioritize national security, LLMs reject it). References dyadic morality (Gray & Schein). Under-scored at mp_max=50.

secondary_assessments.file: 2025-Wu-The Staircase of Ethics Multi-step Moral Dilemmas.md
secondary_assessments.theory_detail: 3,302 five-stage escalating moral dilemmas. Tests how LLMs recalibrate moral judgments as dilemma complexity increases. References dual process theory.
secondary_assessments.size_note: 3,302 five-stage dilemmas (16,510 total decision points)
secondary_assessments.gem_rationale: FIRST multi-step escalating moral dilemma benchmark. 5-stage progression reveals value priority shifts. Care often superseded by fairness in complex contexts. Novel dynamic evaluation paradigm. mp_max=50 underrates.
